svg.title: CSA: rough prediction and refinement
svg.desc: Paper-style schematic of the modern CSA implementation. The rough U-Net predicts a coarse completion. The refinement U-Net receives the coarse composite and masked input. Coherent semantic attention is applied to the 32 by 32 encoder features, before the bottleneck. Final compositing preserves known pixels. Train rough first, then freeze it while training refinement.
svg.text: Discriminators and loss networks are used only during training.
Modern implementation; layer groups are schematic.
